title: Roadside Dispatch Under Road Hazard Protection
content:
Roadside calls under Road Hazard Protection are dispatched through the plan's roadside channel, the Crestline roadside line, and only on plans that list the service among their roadside services.

**Call remaining.** The certificate must have a roadside call remaining, and be active, when a roadside service is dispatched. A call requested after the allowance is used up is not covered.

**One call per dispatch.** Each dispatched call uses one call, whether it was a flat-tire change or a tow.

**Payment caps.** A flat-tire change is paid up to the plan's flat-change cap, and a tow up to the plan's tow cap, to the plan's tow destination, the nearest Crestline store. Any amount above the cap is billed by the provider to the holder.

| Situation | Covered dispatch? | Calls used | Plan pays |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active certificate, call remaining, service listed on the plan | yes | 1 | up to the service's cap |
| No call remaining | no | — | nothing |
| Service not listed on the plan | no | — | nothing |

*Hypothetical illustrations.* A flat-tire change billed at 95.00 on a plan with a 75.00 flat-change cap: the plan pays 75.00 and the provider bills the holder 20.00. A certificate with 1 call left that dispatches a tow has 0 calls left afterward, and a later request is not covered.
